name: Amy Joyce
title: Clinical Psychologist, Psychologist
description: Amy has a broad range of clinical interests including mood and anxiety disorders, perinatal issues, personality disorders and she has particular expertise and interest in interpersonal trauma. She aims to empower individiuals to overcome the impact of early traumatic and/or challenging life experiences to work toward developing more adaptive and functional current relationships. She is trained in Cognitive Behavioural Therapy (CBT), Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT), Dialectical Behaviour Therapy (DBT), Eye Movement Desensitisation and Reprocessing (EMDR) and psychodynamic approaches also inform her practice. Amy's areas of interest and expertise include: Trauma Perinatal issues Personality disorders Mood & Anxiety disorders Psychotic disorders Grief, loss and adjustment issues General social or interpersonal difficulties
